projectDescription: Autonomous AI sales agent that finds prospects, writes personalized cold email campaigns, handles replies, and books meetings — running on your Claude or Codex subscription with no per-token API billing.
keyFeatures: No per-token API billing — runs on your Claude Pro/Max or ChatGPT subscription
23 configurable prospect signals (SERP rank, tech stack, ad pixels, agency detection, etc.)
Four-stage prospecting pipeline: Discover → Profile → Enrich → Verify
Personalized 3-email cold sequences written by an AI Writer agent
Outbox approval ladder — nothing sends without your review (unless you opt out)
Deterministic pre-send gate rejects unrendered merge tags, banned phrases, and bad addresses
Reply Handler classifies intent and advances conversation stages automatically
Web dashboard (localhost:5555) with Today queue, cohort builder, and outbox decisions desk
Editable skills library in plain Markdown — change prompts without touching code
Built-in CAN-SPAM compliance with postal address and opt-out footer enforcement
Subscription quota tracking and budget caps per provider
CSV export for any external sequencer (Instantly, Smartlead, etc.)
publicApiSurface: harvey.yaml: persona, product, icp, channels, usage, brain, writer, compliance
.env: GMAIL_*, M365_*, SMTP_*, REOON_API_KEY, DATAFORSEO_*, SERPER_API_KEY, PRECLEARED_API_KEY
